operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to write the white paper on their own.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the white paper coming along?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s moving forward. I initially planned to write it on my own, but I’m now working on it with a co-author.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a useful shift. What’s the paper focused on?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It covers data-governance trends, and the outline has already been approved.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice—having the outline approved should make the drafting stage smoother. Have you started writing yet?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, drafting has started, and collaborating has made it easier to divide up the sections.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier solo-writing plan for the white paper and retain the current co-authored plan and details.
